subject: general
question: What is the range of the Hansa NG trainer aircraft launched in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**620 nautical miles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hansa NG (Next Generation) trainer aircraft has a range of **620 nautical miles**, making it suitable for training and short missions.
 
• It is an advanced version of the original Hansa aircraft, developed by the **National Aerospace Laboratories (NAL), Bengaluru.**
 
• The aircraft is designed for **pilot training, surveillance, and general aviation purposes.**
 
• Hansa NG features a **fuel-efficient engine**, lightweight design, and state-of-the-art avionics.
 
• The aircraft is expected to play a significant role in **boosting India's aviation training infrastructure** and promoting indigenously developed technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Aerospace Laboratories (NAL):**

 
 
• It is a premier aerospace research center in India under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• NAL focuses on development of civil aircraft, advanced technologies, and aerospace systems.
 
• Hansa NG is one of its flagship projects in the domain of general aviation.
 
 
 
• **Trainer Aircraft:**
 
 
• Trainer aircraft are specifically designed for pilot training.
 
• They feature dual controls, allowing instructors to assist trainees during flight.
 
• Hansa NG is considered ideal for basic flight training due to its compact size and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Avionics:**
 
 
• Avionics refers to electronic systems used in aircraft for navigation, communication, and monitoring.
 
• Hansa NG is equipped with modern avionics to enhance pilot training and operational capabilities.
 
 
 
• **General Aviation:**
 
 
• General aviation covers all civilian flying activities outside of commercial airline operations.
 
• Hansa NG aims to strengthen India's general aviation sector by offering an indigenously developed solution.
